fact: The 2022-2023 primary statistical yearbook, published May 2024, states that the ministry's BSD scaled up the digital data collection piloted since 2017 with UNICEF support, and that the 2022-23 school census was held only in the first half of 2024 for lack of funding, with AFD, GPE and UNICEF financing the yearbook.
title: Annuaire statistique Enseignement Primaire 2022-2023
publisher: Ministère de l'Enseignement Pré-universitaire et de l'Alphabétisation, Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement
